Initial public release.

- Instantly generate 1080p videos from text or scripts with no manual video editing required.
- Simple, guided workflow: upload your text/script, describe your needs, and receive a ready MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session and cloud backend connection, including free anonymous-token for new users.
- Handles uploads, export, credits/balance checks, and project status via straightforward commands.
- Supports major video, image, and audio formats up to 500MB.
- Helpful prompts and clear error feedback for smooth user experience.
